verdict.rationale: No BLOCKER and no MAJOR (critical/important) findings. Two RECOMMENDED (annotation-level numeric consistency drift in single table cells: line 314 in Code Inspection Evidence and line 332 FD-6 cell) surfaced — both are residue of the v1.1.0 patch that fixed I-DR-101 in most sections but missed these two cells. Per KB-review-disciplines §architecture-audit explicit guidance, annotation-level numeric-consistency drift is downgraded to MINOR/RECOMMENDED (the auditor's xhigh-reasoning budget is not the right place for count-vs-enumeration micro-checks; Gate 1's Numeric Internal Consistency check should have caught). The substantive architecture — option (a) selection rationale, the 8-file + 1-outside inventory honoring FR-4, the dispatch_directives[] indirection (Contract 6), the v1 invoking_agent invariant clarification, the F-7 conditional AC, the ADR-0044/0045 authorship, the DISSENT-2 carry-through, the D-004-before-D-001 edit ordering, the inheritance of 13 prior ADRs — are sound, evidentially anchored, and consistent across the Blueprint and the new ADRs. The Blueprint advances to Plan Authoring; the two RECOMMENDED items can be absorbed in finalize-reconciler's next sweep or surface as a v1.2.0 polish patch at the user's discretion.
